title: SQL Server CDC: a text or binary value over 64 KB fails the source statement

found.by: lfc-schema-change-test ddl-matrix sql sqlserver cdc --setup utility-1.7, SQL Server 2022 CU27 Developer

symptom: UPDATE ... SET lob = <1 MB NVARCHAR(MAX)> on a CDC table fails with Msg 7139 (length of LOB data to be replicated exceeds configured maximum 65536); a 60 KB value works
cause: SQL Server's 'max text repl size (B)' (default 65,536 bytes) applies to tables enabled for CDC
effect: the source's own write fails, so the application sees the error and nothing is captured
fix: Not tested: raise it on the source, EXEC sp_configure 'max text repl size', -1; RECONFIGURE (SQL Server's documented setting)
